k163_r2: One small compact object or point that stands alone on a plain, smooth background: an insect on a wall or a leaf, a hook or a kettle hanging against an empty sky, the small knob or tip of an object, the navel of an orange, an eye on a smooth head seen from the side.
k23_r2: People seen from a little distance, centred on the head and upper body (one or two people standing, playing, sitting at a desk). Also: the face of a pale long-haired small dog, such as a Maltese, a Westie or a Yorkshire terrier.
c101_r2: A furry animal's face, centred on the nose (shaggy dogs, cats, lynx, lemurs, foxes, Pomeranians), or the hub of a wheel with spokes or an alloy rim.
